metadata.notes: The real, cited J. Kenji López-Alt / Serious Eats 'extra-crispy roast potatoes' technique, closing ROADMAP.md's own long-named gap (first flagged 2026-08-13 alongside complete-potato.json's own capability test: 'the real alkaline (baking-soda) parboil-roughening technique... remain open'). durationSeconds on ALKALINE_PARBOIL (600s = 10 minutes) and ROAST (3000s = 50 minutes, the cited figure for a parboiled batch — see roast.json's own durationNote) both match the real recipe's own cited timing directly, not arbitrary picks within the declared range. See data/actions/alkaline_parboil.json, data/actions/roast.json, data/entities/baking_soda.json, and REFERENCES.md for the full citation chain.
metadata.saltInParboilWaterNote: The real recipe also salts the parboiling water (2 tbsp per 2 quarts) — deliberately NOT modeled as a step here, same reasoning alkaline_parboil.json's own saltInWaterNote gives: this repo's SALT verb targets a food entity directly, not a bulk cooking liquid, and water.json has no additive-concept capability for it yet.
